{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing systematic undershoot that narrows as forecast horizon extends",
    "One-day-ahead forecasts exhibit significant bias correction as they converge toward current prices",
    "Sentiment signals have stronger effect on near-term forecasts while long-term forecasts show more mean reversion to historical price levels",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.00), model undershoots more than baseline, reflecting delayed price reaction",
    "Negative sentiment (-0.33) has minimal impact on forecasts, showing sentiment can be ignored when clearly negative",
    "Price levels below the 18-day average receive larger forecast bumps than prices at or above the average",
    "Forecast divergence from true outcomes increases with forecast horizon up to a plateau at approximately 10-15 days"
] }
